title: StepGateArtifact (composition §13.6, new)
description: Logical id 'stepgate.artifact/v1'. Per-node signed gate with StopGateArtifact semantics along the TIME axis (primitive 9). Authored STANDALONE, not allOf StopGateArtifact.schema.v0.1.json, for two reasons (STATUS §1.2a): that base is additionalProperties:false (would reject the step fields) and pins verdict to PASS/FAIL/REVIEW/INDETERMINATE. Verdict here uses the spec taxonomy with mapping OK↔PASS, VIOLATION↔FAIL. promise/progress are advisory scores; the verdict remains harness-owned (v = g_H(e)).

node_id.description: the obligation-graph node this gate covers

signature.description: ed25519 over canonical serialization, per StopGateArtifact
